title: 3 Stocks to Buy on the Dip-and 1 to Avoid
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Kieran Francis of the Fintech Channel to sort software's AI-driven selloff (the S&P 500 software index is down ~15% YTD) into winners and losers, triggered by Anthropic's Claude Co-work agentic model. His framework: seat-based pricing models are most exposed to AI agents, while usage-based models are resilient since AI must still consume the service. Three buys: CrowdStrike (CRWD) - cybersecurity 'turbocharged' by AI, with AI-enabled attacks up 89% and zero-days up 42% in 2025; its AI-native platform grew revenue 47% YoY and it has begun recovering from the selloff; Zscaler (ZS) - zero-trust pioneer with the new Square X AI browser for securing AI agents, trading at roughly one-quarter of CrowdStrike's price-to-sales, though riskier given rising competition from Cloudflare and hyperscalers; Datadog (DDOG) - the 'hidden gem' data-refinery play doing Palantir's hardest step (organizing data) without Palantir's multiple, usage-based so AI agents still pay, with a high analyst target of $260 vs ~$130 today. One to avoid: Adobe (ADBE) - its seat-based creative business faces both the AI-agent seat collapse and encroaching AI creative tools, making it a turnaround bet Francis refuses to take. Bridget adds Datadog to her paper-trading 'Bridget's Buys' watchlist. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'Kieran'/'Kiran' spellings; SentinelOne and Cloudflare mentioned with no calls.
